findings.summary: The new prefix test `[[ $comp == "$cur"* ]]` lets empty completions through when cur is empty, so blank entries land in COMPREPLY, skip the single-completion branch, show a blank candidate and can block unique auto-completion.

findings.summary: The new prefix match treats completions containing spaces as one literal word. The no-description fast path (line 183) and the menu-complete branch (line 162) still use compgen, so the paths handle spaces inconsistently.

judge.reason: Concerns spaces in completions and path inconsistency, a different complaint from the empty-entry regression.
